s:content.title: Supervision & Support
s:content.subtitle: The team responsible for your academic guidance, technical support, and course coordination throughout the semester.

s:list.s:item: Subject line: Always include [DEMO-101] at the beginning of your subject line.

Professional standards: To ensure a timely response, messages must include the required subject prefix and maintain a professional tone. Messages that do not meet these standards may not receive a reply.
Urgent matters: Flag your email as Important (High Priority) to ensure a response within 48 business hours. Reserve this flag for genuinely urgent matters only.
Follow-up: Do not send a follow-up before 72 business hours have elapsed.
Office hours: Walk-ins are welcome for questions under 10 minutes. Any exchange requiring more time requires a scheduled appointment.
Booking tutorial: Please watch the tutorial below before booking any appointment.

s:tutorial.title: Booking Walkthrough
s:tutorial.s:paragraph: Follow these instructions to prepare your appointment.

s:list.s:item: Questions about grading and course policies

pe:description.s:paragraph: I can provide guidance and feedback, but I do not complete assessed work on your behalf.
